These findings collectively imply that Nimustine can influence the Inner centromere protein via different intermediate targets, potentially through distinct mechanisms. The scores from both paths suggest a moderate level of confidence in the relationship, though the exact nature of the interaction remains uncertain. The evidence supports a possible role for Nimustine in modulating the Inner centromere protein, but further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct interaction.
